_comment_scope: Workspace LHCI config. Per performance.md §1 workspace pages are audited on DESKTOP form factor (Anna persona, 2-monitor workstation). Phase G ships a no-router shell; Phase H wires React Router and adds per-route assertions matching performance.md §2 workspace `/queue` desktop (TTI ≤ 2.5 s, LCP ≤ 2.0 s, CLS ≤ 0.05, score ≥ 0.85).
_comment_timing_thresholds: Numeric timing thresholds (TTI/LCP) are deferred to Phase H — they require working bootstrap which needs BFF /config available. Static-dist LHCI on Phase G shell stops at the `Bootstrap failed: /config HTTP 404` error message. Until BFF or MSW is wired into the CI LHCI run, this config asserts only stable signals: categories:accessibility + categories:best-practices + CLS. Timing assertions stay listed (as `warn`) for PR visibility.

assert._comment_blocking: Blocking assertions — robust against the Phase G bootstrap state. CLS + accessibility + best-practices catch obvious regressions.
assert._comment_warn_phase_h: Timing thresholds (TTI, LCP, score) graduate to `error` in Phase H. Values match performance.md §2 workspace `/queue` desktop.
